notes.title: [New Update] Version 1.1.7 Released
notes.notes:
[New Update]
Ver 1.1.7 of FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves has been released.
Please update to this newest version from your respective platform's home menu.

■Update Timing
6/3/2025, 21:00 PM (PDT)

■Update Details
The patch notes for this update can be read via the link below:
https://www.snk-corp.co.jp/us/games/fatalfury-cotw/img/main/patch_1.1.7.pdf

Thank you for your continued support of FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves.

notes.title: [Update Notice]Ver 1.1.7 Update scheduled for release
notes.notes:
[Update Notice]
Ver 1.1.7 of FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves will be released at 9:00 PM (PDT).
This update will include various bug fixes and some adjustments to character balance.
 
Thank you for your continued support of FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves.
#SNK #FatalFury #CotW
